result.response:
Here is the recap of your 3-day **Jovunara Pilates** New Year campaign (`ujomx`), which ran across the full flight from **Wednesday, January 6, 2027, 00:00 Dhaka time (`2027-01-05T18:00:00Z`) through Friday, January 8, 2027, 24:00 Dhaka time (`2027-01-08T18:00:00Z`)** and is now completed and paused.

---

### 1. Campaign Performance Summary

| Metric | Total |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Total Spend** | **$634.24 USD** (`634,237,356` micros; 97.6% of the $650.00 cap) |
| **Impressions** | **1,038,878** (`1,006,400` unique reach; `1.03` avg. frequency) |
| **Link Clicks** | **1,082** |
| **Average Cost per Link Click (CPC)** | **$0.59 USD** (`$0.586`) |
| **Link Click-Through Rate (CTR)** | **0.104%** |
| **Total Engagements** | **7,723** (`1,082` clicks, `163` likes, `6` replies, `3` reposts) |

---

### 2. What the Reporting Actually Shows (Link Clicks vs. Trial Starts)

- **No Conversion/Trial-Start Visibility in X Ads:** Because `https://jovunarapilates.app/start` does not have an X conversion pixel (`web_event_tag`) or mobile app conversion tracking installed, **X Ads reporting only measures upper-funnel delivery and engagement metrics (`impressions`, `link_clicks`, `engagements`, and `billed_charge_local_micro`)**. It cannot observe or report how many of those **1,082 link clicks** completed a landing-page visit or started a 7-day free trial in the App Store.
- **How We Optimized for Trial-Start Eligibility:** Since X could only optimize for `LINK_CLICKS` (`WEBSITE_CLICKS` objective), we enforced strict eligibility rules on every ad group so budget was never wasted on clicks that could not convert into trial starts:
  1. **Exclusively iOS (`PLATFORM = iOS`):** Excluded Android, desktop, and other devices so every click came from an iOS device capable of installing the iPhone-only app.
  2. **Worldwide Except China (`LOCATION NE China`):** Excluded China (`CN`) across all ad groups while leaving all other markets open to leverage your localized landing page and app.
  3. **No Unapproved Copy:** Used only your three approved posts (`2138696687416686580`, `2138877881350341546`, `2139059075284323251`).

---

### 3. Performance by Ad Group (Line Item) & Flight Optimizations

We launched four iOS (ex-China) ad groups to test distinct audience segments and reallocated budget throughout the flight based on cost per link click (CPC) and CTR:

| Line Item | Audience Segment (All iOS only, excluding China) | Status | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC | Link CTR |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **LI2 (`ym4ru`)** | **Health, Fitness & Workouts Interests** (*Workouts, Health & Fitness, Nutrition, Dance, Athletics*) | Scaled Up (Completed) | **$257.74** | 410,079 | **472** | **$0.55** | **0.115%** |
| **LI1 (`dqmmz`)** | **High-Intent Keywords** (*pilates, back pain, back care, lower back, posture, stretching, mobility, core workout, home workout, new year resolution*) | Active Full Flight (Completed) | **$208.60** | 360,455 | **351** | **$0.59** | **0.097%** |
| **LI3 (`hqsz9`)** | **Desk Workers & End-of-Workday Reset** (*Career, Software Dev, Entrepreneurship, Business & Finance + desk job, remote work, WFH, ergonomics*) | Active Full Flight (Completed) | **$150.46** | 258,427 | **246** | **$0.61** | **0.095%** |
| **LI4 (`4jogk`)** | **Followers & Follower Lookalikes** (`@JovunaraPilates`) | Paused on Day 1 | **$17.44** | 9,917 | **13** | **$1.34** | **0.131%** |
| **Total** | | | **$634.24** | **1,038,878** | **1,082** | **$0.59** | **0.104%** |

**Key Adjustments Made During the Flight:**
- **Cut Underperforming Lookalikes Early (`LI4`):** After 6 hours, `LI4` (Followers & Lookalikes) showed a **$1.35 CPC**—more than double the cost per click of our other three ad groups. We reduced its budget immediately and paused it at hour 18 (`$17.44` spend, `13` link clicks).
- **Scaled Health & Fitness Workouts (`LI2`) and High-Intent Pilates/Back-Care Keywords (`LI1`):** `LI2` consistently delivered the lowest CPC (**$0.55**) and highest link CTR (**0.115%**), followed closely by `LI1` (**$0.59 CPC**) and `LI3` (**$0.61 CPC**). Shifting budget into `LI2` and `LI1` across Days 2 and 3 reduced overall campaign CPC from **$0.75** in the first 6 hours to **$0.59** by the end of the flight.

---

### 4. Performance by Approved Post

All three approved posts ran across the ad groups, with **Post `2138877881350341546`**—which explicitly pre-qualified users in the copy (*"Nine-minute guided Pilates routines for everyday back care. Start Jovunara Pilates with a 7-day free trial by January 10, 2027. iPhone (iOS) only; available worldwide except China."*)—driving the highest volume and CTR:
